Both the president and his minister stepped forward to shake hands with Kura. They both have dark hair and olive skin, a signature trait of ethnic Hydronians.

Welcome! I am President Zorlu and this is my associate, minister Erdemir, said Kaplan, whilst gesturing to his colleague.
If youll follow me, we have a car waiting to take us to the conference room, he said smiling.[/quote]

Kura slightly bowed her head to the president and minister, shaking both their hands and gaining note of her surroundings.

[i]"That would be most appreciated. It is a great honour meeting with Hydronia, back in the empire there was much talk of a partnership with your nation. Though, due to the Empress's current state, such plans were delayed. But nonetheless, let us not waste time and get to establishing prosperous relations."[/i] Kura said calmly as she followed Zorlu towards the car, and would be the first to sit down inside, adjusting her cape as she got inside and taking off her gloves.

But nonetheless, let us not waste time and get to establishing prosperous relations."[/i] Kura said calmly as she followed Zorlu towards the car, and would be the first to sit down inside, adjusting her cape as she got inside and taking off her gloves.[/quote]

The two men entered the car after her. The president signaled to the driver to begin the journey. The car made it's way through the busy Hydronian streets and after a 25 minute journey, ground to a halt outside a grand building with marbled pillars.

"This is the royal imperial conference hall," explained Minister Erdemir as they exited the vehicle, "It was constructed in 1603 during the peak of the Holy Hydronic Empire. It was used for important government meetings. It was shut down and turned into a historical site after the reformed government took over, but in the recent years we have reopened it and used it for occasions such as this,"
"I hope your hungry!" said the president as they entered the hall.

Marble Pillars also lined the interior of the building. There are various old religious paintings on the ceiling and the walls are a burnt orange colour. In the middle of the room is a long, wooden table with an intricately woven table cloth covering it. On top of the table is a selection of Hydronian food ,ranging from exotic flavours of yogurt ,to traditional bread, to various cuts of horse meat.

"Feel free to try whatever you want," said Kaplan as he gestured towards the food.

[i]"Hmm. [quote=united_hydronia;59092971][b]The Great Parliamentary Assembly - 11th April 2025[/b]

Voices echoed across the chamber as the ministers of Hydronia assembled once again. This time they had assembled not to discuss new legislation, but to discuss Thývens recent developments.

One day earlier, a THEP meeting had been held, where Thýven threatened tariffs if their goals of complete unification where not met. When the president and his Defense minister returned from the meeting, President Zorlu immediately called a meeting with his cabinet. In this meeting they discussed potential courses of action and came to the decision that Hydronia would take part in a THEP confederation if one was ever negotiated, but Hydronia would not stand for excessive tariffs coming from their allies. The minister of foreign affairs is now presenting a policy to allow the governments plan of action to go ahead, authorising the formation of a possible THEP confederation.

You really want to give up our sovereignty to country that still retains an oppressive monarchy! Shouted Far-right leader Dural Agca.
They do NOT retain any kind of oppressive regime, they have a monarchy due to tradition and its their choice whether they keep it, not ours, replied Halis Erdemir, minister of foreign affairs.
And what are you going to do about the tariffs, youre allowing us to be bullied into submission! Shouted Dural.
SHUT YOUR MOUTH YOU FASCIST FOOL! Cried an unknown voice from Kaplans side of the room, provoking anger from the right.
SILENCE! Shouted the president, trying to calm down the assembly m. Eventually the noise lowered and the debate began again.
It is in our best interests to form a confederation and if not that then to create closer ties within THEP. This is not because of any tariffs imposed on us, but because THEP is unorganised. Even with the Security Council implemented, we need more unity. All we want to do is pass legislation that would authorise the THEP ministry to take part in actions that satisfy our needs of unity. These actions could be forming a confederation or simply lower border restrictions. Said Erdemir, trying to convince the other side. After hours of intense debate a vote was held. The legislation passed, with Zorlus party along with the Eco alliance voting for the legislation and the right wing parties voting against. The legislation passed swiftly through the house of governors with no amendments being made to it.

Even though the legislation had passed, The president still felt that more needed to be discussed, so he called another cabinet meeting after the parliament session. During this meeting, they discussed the behaviour of Thývens new king, Erjk. They discussed his behavioural changes from his mothers rule and the possibility that he is attempting to control Hydronia and the rest of THEP. Thýven is a powerful ally, so they decided it would be best to simply observe for now and try to stay on the good side of Erjk.

[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation] (you dont have to respond, I just thought Id ping you since Thýven is mentioned in the text)

[b]11 April 2025

SummitONE Solutions

Memorandum

Subject: Developments and Projects in Sal-Baliz[/b]

[list]

[i]WARNING

This document contains information that may or may not concern the strategic interests of the Commonwealth of High Albany and is subject to Chapter 7, section 7.3, of the SummitONE Code of Ethics and Conduct, as amended. The transmission, distribution, or duplication of this memorandum by unauthorized persons or entities is prohibited under law.[/i]

[/list]

[b]I. RECENT EVENTS[/b]

1. Much has transpired in the interim between the initial conclusion of Sal-Baliz's deal with SummitONE and now. With prospects of confederalization from the member states of THEP, SummitONE has reviewed its present resources with the highest scrutiny. Following analysis of preexisting infrastructure, SummitONE has concluded that Sal-Baliz does not presently possess the military capabilities to fend off present enemy offensives on its territory, whether in manpower, material, food and water, and other essential resources. Hence, while corporate resources remain steadfast in honoring our most recent agreement, SummitONE believes that an expansion of present operations will be necessary to ensure the continuation of military resistance.

2. Hydronia, Etherniasti, and Thýven are the three most dangerous opponents of Sal-Baliz at the present. While SummitONE Solutions remains optimistic in the capability of the Corps of Commissionaires in fending off their advance, we are cautiously optimisitc of the capabilities of the Sal-Baliz militias. As it stands, morale among Sal-Baliz forces remains shockingly high and is expected to continue as further foreign encroachment continues in West Shamat. Yet, limitations in the standardization of armaments, poor literacy, superstition, language barriers with SummitONE operatives, and limited understanding of medicine and engineering are severely hampering military efforts. There exists a deep social divide between the most capable of fighters trained to fight with SummitONE vehicles and armaments, versus more traditional guerillas who have yet to fully adapt to SummitONE strategy and tactics.

3. Ulf de Mayne, the current Regional Operations Manager, has expressed discontent with the current state of the conflict. Following the departure of Freya Moran on contact with the Elseyrian branch, the SummitONE command structure has been unnecessarily strained, especially following the deaths of major operatives William Arud and Terrence Alsvik last March. However, following the conclusion of the SummitONE contact in Elseyr, Freya Moran is expected to return to Sal-Baliz soon together with a host of other veterans. The comapny remains hopeful that this injection of fresh reinforcements shall encourage command to operate on a rotational basis to reduce exhaustion and combat fatigue, while also promoting a more sustainable work environment among contractors. Sal-Baliz command remains steadfast and capable due to nature of defensive war, though the company recommends adopting a rotational system as well to ensure that commander of smaller sub-units remain primed and ready during combat.

4. Sal-Baliz losses have been significant throughout the conflict, but SummitONE losses remain low. Apart from the deaths of Commander William Arud and Specialist Terrence Alvik on 28 March 2025, casualties have so far remained minimal thanks to SummitONE prioritization of strategic consultation over frontline involvement. However, as SummitONE expects to increase its operations over the coming months, this trend may not continue for long. We hope to negotiate a larger, more lucrative contract with Sal-Baliz to shoulder the burden of these risks.

[b]II. DEVELOPMENTS AND PROJECTS[/b]

1. At the time of writing, 23 factories have been successfully constructed in Sal-Baliz, the majority constructed near the central territories of the state where they are safest against THEP aerial bombing runs. 3 of these factories are operated directly by SummitONE Technologies for production of terrestrial vehicles, 8 are operated directly by SummitONE Technologies for production of artillery, explosives, and drone technology, 3 are operated partially by SummitONE Intelligence for production of radar and cyberwarfare technologies, while the rest are wholly owned by Sal-Baliz operatives for production of small arms, munitions, and non-lethal material such as body armor, meals-ready-to-eat (MREs), sandbags, gasoline, and combat casualty response kits.

2. Al-Sharwa has been successfully transformed into a comprehensive military compound by SummitONE Technologies and SummitONE Corps of Commissionaires. AOpsMgr. Cedric Falwell currently administers the territory with the supporting of SummitONE's Alpha Company of Commissionaires. As of the moment, the settlement has been repurposed as a training ground for Sal-Baliz operatives aiming to enlist as contractors for the company's training regimen and as a weapons stockpile for tanks, IFVs, and other armored vehicles that have yet to be deployed into the conflict.

3. Around 40 tanks have been produced by SummitONE Technologies, 80% of them from modular assemblies in Norrhollow and 20% from factories within Sal-Baliz. We anticipate numbers to increase to 300 tanks per month once Seagate Zurekdal becomes fully operational. In addition to this, SummitONE has finished producing 800 artillery systems, 3 fighter aircraft, 15 combat helicopters, and an undisclosed number of small arms capable of arming no less than 40% of Sal-Baliz's entire active fighting force in battle. The production of medical kits has been slow in recent weeks due to supply limitations, as have been the production of body armor and other non-lethal material, though these are expected to be alleviated soon.

4. Seagate Zurekdal, a major prefabricated port-building project of SummitONE Seagates, has finished most of its non-military infrastructure. While further infrastructure is still necessary so that the site could be used as a regular naval base, it is now partially capable of serving as a port for SummitONE dark ships to enter and seamlessly ship resources directly to Sal-Baliz. Caisson-based floating platforms have been installed to serve as docking sites for new ships, while solar powered farms and desalination barges help sustain personnel on the Seagate. Barracks, storage facilities, and naval batteries are still in the midst of construction but are expected to be accomplished by the next year. Nuclear microreactors are still pending construction due to delays in material sourcing and bureaucratic scrutiny from the Ministry of Energy.

5. SummitONE Technologies has formulated five sets of MREs to supplant Sal-Baliz's current combat rations: Standard A (Chicken Biryani), Standard B (Lamb Kofta), Standard C (Beef Stew w/ Apricots), Standard D (Falafel & Tabbouleh), and the Mobile Kitchen Module (Beef Keema, Chicken Kabsa, Beef Stew w/ Apricots). The Standard modules each contain approximately 1,2501,300 kcal per meal, 1318% protein, 3035% fat, 5055% carbohydrates, and with essential vitamins and minerals. The Mobile Kitchen Module is of similar composition, but designed to sustain at least 50 operatives per unit. All MREs are expected to last for up to 36 months at 27°C, though modules may last beyond 5 years in refrigeration. All MREs do not require gasoline to heat, instead possessing magnesium-based water-activated tray heaters. All MREs have been independently verified to be halal by the Institute of Culinary Arts at the University of the Hollows, Norrhollow, though additional processing may be undertaken at Sal-Baliz to ensure maximum compliance with religious laws.
